Package com.codereviewagent.api.service

Class GitHubService

java.lang.Object
com.codereviewagent.api.service.GitHubService
@Service public class GitHubService extends Object
Loads public GitHub metadata and bounded source archives for a pinned commit.

  • Constructor Details

    • GitHubService

      @Autowired public GitHubService(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper mapper, @Value("${app.github-token:}") String token, @Value("${app.max-archive-bytes}") long maxArchiveBytes, @Value("${app.max-files}") int maxFiles, @Value("${app.max-file-bytes}") int maxFileBytes, @Value("${app.max-total-source-bytes}") long maxTotalSourceBytes)
      Creates a GitHub client with configured archive and source-size limits.
      Parameters:
      mapper - JSON parser for GitHub responses
      token - optional GitHub API credential
      maxArchiveBytes - compressed archive limit
      maxFiles - maximum accepted source file count
      maxFileBytes - maximum accepted file size
      maxTotalSourceBytes - maximum accepted decompressed source size

    • resolveCommit

      public String resolveCommit(GitHubService.Repo repo, String ref)
      Resolves a branch or commit reference to a 40-character commit SHA.
      Parameters:
      repo - parsed repository identity
      ref - branch or commit reference
      Returns:
      immutable 40-character commit SHA
      Throws:
      org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException - when the ref is invalid or GitHub returns an invalid response

    • archive

      public GitHubService.SourceArchive archive(GitHubService.Repo repo, String sha) throws IOException, InterruptedException
      Downloads and bounds a commit archive, rejecting unsafe redirects and files.
      Parameters:
      repo - parsed repository identity
      sha - immutable 40-character commit SHA
      Returns:
      accepted source files and skip warnings
      Throws:
      IOException - when the archive is invalid, too large, unsafe, or unreadable
      InterruptedException - when the archive request is interrupted

      Maps a supported source filename extension to the API language identifier.

      path - source filename or path
      Returns:
      normalized language identifier, or null when unsupported
